relationships.subject: WNK-SPAK pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The WNK-SPAK signaling pathway acts as a major coupling mechanism between intracellular chloride levels and KCC2 conformation.

relationships.subject: astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: Astrocytes contribute to this process by up-regulating NKCC1 in response to inflammatory or mechanical injury to the astrocyte

relationships.subject: NKCC1
relationships.evidence_quote: The transition from an excitatory GABAergic response to a mature inhibitory response is dependent upon the simultaneous down-regulation of NKCC1 and the up-regulation of KCC2

key_findings: Review proposes chloride microdomains shaped by KCC2 nanodomains, NKCC1 and astrocyte buffering set local GABAergic inhibitory polarity
